trigger_queries.note: a git operation, not the session lifecycle

evals.prompt: New session. Get me started on the next thing to do.
evals.expected_output: The agent confirms pwd and branch, runs ./init.sh, reads progress.md (Current State, newest Session Log entry) and git log --oneline -5, lists ready items, and claims exactly one by setting it in-progress with the branch name stripped of any account prefix; it does not commit or push.
assertions: Exactly one item is set in-progress
The branch recorded has no account prefix

evals.prompt: Wrap up the session: the fix is implemented, the sandbox is still running.
evals.expected_output: The agent updates only its own Current State lines and Last Updated date, prepends a dated Session Log entry with the handoff sections, sets the item's evidence to PARTIAL naming what ran and that the sandbox is pending (a blocker, not a pass), and leaves ./init.sh green.
assertions: The pending sandbox is recorded as not run, not as passed
The Session Log entry is prepended, newest first
Evidence is marked PARTIAL with exact commands and totals

evals.prompt: After rebasing on main, feature_list.json has a conflict: both sides added an item at the end.
evals.expected_output: The agent keeps both items, places them in id order, renames one id if they collide, resolves progress.md with the newest Last Updated and both Session Log entries newest first, then runs bun test test/agent-harness test/agent-skills.
assertions: Items end in id order with unique ids
The harness contract test is run after resolving
